summary: Gauzy Ltd., an Israeli Nasdaq-listed smart-glass maker, disclosed via Form 6-K that the Tel Aviv-Jaffa District Court granted final, effective approval on September 8, 2026 of a court-sanctioned debt settlement under Israel's Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law (equivalent to a US Chapter 11 plan confirmation), resolving roughly $61 million of pre-petition secured, employee, priority and unsecured claims. Creditors holding 98.96% of voting claims, including 100% of secured lenders OIC Investment Agent LLC and Bank Mizrahi-Tefahot, approved. A $7 million management-led PIPE backstops working capital. The stay is lifted and legacy litigation resolved. Watch post-settlement liquidity and Nasdaq listing compliance.
